Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished 16:9 visual SAMPLE of a Hindi sentence-building adventure for a six year old. Reference image 1 supplies ONLY the approved simple watercolor background, warm detailed wooden asset style, girl singing clue and large navy Hindi lettering. Replace the staircase task completely with a RAILWAY LEVEL CROSSING task. Reference image 2 is the exact original Swifty mascot; preserve its character identity, clothing and flat illustrated style.

Layout: sparse pale sky-blue watercolor backdrop and pale sandy path, almost no plants or environmental clutter. A clear road leads from lower-left foreground across two steel railway rails running horizontally through the middle distance, continuing beyond the tracks into a softly faded empty distance. Show a CLOSED red-and-white striped railway barrier arm across this road, attached logically to a pivot motor post at the right side of the road, rails behind the closed arm. The crossing and barrier are large and clearly recognizable, the road visibly crosses the track rather than follows it. No train, no cars, no cluttered landscape.
Place the original Swifty standing on the near safe side at left, waiting before the lowered barrier. Upper left: a compact white rounded thought bubble with the same girl singing as the reference, clear visual clue.
The central interaction is FIVE large warm light wooden word sockets integrated in a horizontal puzzle panel mounted onto the lowered crossing barrier, all readable and facing the viewer. First socket already contains exactly "लड़की"; remaining FOUR sockets empty with subtle golden edges. The barrier is physically visibly down behind the sockets, and will rise after sentence completion. Provide a small green inactive lamp on the barrier motor post. Avoid extra words or instructions.
Bottom third: eight generous warm wooden tappable option tiles in two rows of four, exact text row1 "लड़की", "गाना", "गा", "रही"; row2 "है।", "खेल", "किताब", "रहा". Bold extremely legible dark navy Devanagari. First लड़की option slightly faded to indicate already placed. The intended answer is लड़की गाना गा रही है। Keep options clean, fully visible, even size, strong text contrast. Visual hierarchy focuses on words and crossing.
NO top map icon, NO six dots, NO speaker, NO HUD, NO title, NO instructional labels, no arrows, no staircase. No photorealistic landscape. Same quality and restrained background as reference. This is a single coherent full-screen game sample, not a storyboard or collage.
correction: Change only closed crossing lamp to red.

The red-and-white boom barrier must rotate UP around its RIGHT motor-post pivot to near vertical at the right edge, leaving a clearly unobstructed road across the railway tracks. Signal lamp GREEN. Keep the eight option tiles at bottom but fade the five used correct choices, retain distractors. Same original white duck mascot in yellow hoodie and blue shorts, now walking away from viewer along center road over crossing, naturally smaller by perspective. Do not add a train or cars.
